posts.title: Spike and Stabilize: Two Modes for Product Development
posts.description: We can spend weeks building something nobody needs. This post explores Dan North's Spike and Stabilize as two modes for product development, one to learn what is worth building and one to make it long-term maintainable, and how AI can help us learn sooner.

posts.title: TDD and Coding Agents: Is It Theater?
posts.description: Does a coding agent need every step of Red-Green-Refactor? I tried to find out. Here is what I changed, what I measured, and what I learned.

posts.title: App-First: Fake It Till You Make It
posts.description: Why does app development have to wait until the API is ready? This is how my team turned the company's App-First principle into a practice: we released a good-enough fake API in production, and let backend and app development run in parallel.
